timing_basis: UTC wall-clock timestamps observed from Python datetime.now(timezone.utc). Packet start is the request/manifest read, not model inference start. Case work was interleaved in one participant context.

model.reason: Exact model identity, invocation settings, token accounting, and cost were not exposed; none inferred.

participant_context.disclosure: These seven cases share one participant conversation and model context. All seven requests/manifests were read before any response was written. Relevant skill text and the HO-14 source were also visible in shared context. Responses are separately authored artifacts, not independent model replications.
participant_context.isolation_limits: Inherited environment instructions and available-skill/memory summary metadata were present. No source-repository files, memory files, evaluation keys/rubrics, other-arm packet files, or prior participant outputs were accessed. Only assigned packet paths and the HO-14 permitted primary source were consulted for task content.

skill_selection.name: mbse-verification-evidence
skill_selection.use: Define comparable measured intervals, configuration and conditions, uncertainty, outcome reporting, and inference limits.

skill_read_events.use: Used observation/configuration/uncertainty/acceptance separation; did not impose a complete trace-package template.

skill_scope_note: File inventory and byte hashing cover all supplied packages, but only paths in skill_read_events were exposed as skill text for this case. Other cases share the participant context.

tools.name: functions.exec
tools.use: Orchestrate local packet reads, output writes, and integrity recording.

tools.name: exec_command
tools.use: Read request/manifest and selected skill text; write output.md and run-record.json; compute SHA-256; observe UTC wall-clock times.

local_checks.scope: Artifact integrity only; no engineering test, application execution, inspection, approval, or performance scoring was performed.

exceptions.detail: The first shell inventory attempt used python, which was not found. It was retried successfully with python3. No input changes occurred in that attempt; its exact start timestamp was not recorded.
Shared participant context is disclosed and cannot support independent-replication or secure holdout claims.

output_hashes_exclude: run-record.json itself, to avoid a recursive self-hash.
external_source_note: No external source retrieved for this case. Historical source statements, where present, were used only as facts supplied in request.md and labeled accordingly.
